t_advice_summary_textbox.text: different coloured gnomes relate to one of two different basket colours. 4 different coloured gnomes will lead to red basket 4 to white. the points of each basket will change over time but stick with one while the going is good. use x1 as a chance to see if the other basket is worth more points. don't risk trying a new basket on a x5 unless the value is already low, 4 or below.

vb_textbox.text: there are 8 coloured gnomes and two baskets. the baskets are are red and yellow. 4 gnomes lead to the red and 4 to the yellow. the values of the baskets will fluctuate thoughout the game but tend to stay steady for a while. rounds will be x1 value or x5. if one basket is providing good amounts stick with it during x5 rounds. check the value of the other basket during x1 rounds. I felt like red was more consistent but this may not be true
